outputs.name: Clean county income
outputs.sql:
-- One row per county. Negative or zero income values are placeholders, so they become NULL.
SELECT
  GEOID AS fips,
  CASE WHEN median_hh_income > 0 THEN median_hh_income END AS median_hh_income,
  CASE WHEN per_capita_income > 0 THEN per_capita_income END AS per_capita_income
FROM inc

outputs.name: Clean county education
outputs.sql:
-- Educational attainment, population 25+ (table B15003).
-- bachelor_plus = bachelor's + master's + professional + doctorate.
SELECT
  GEOID AS fips,
  B15003_E001 AS edu_pop_25plus,
  B15003_E022 + B15003_E023 + B15003_E024 + B15003_E025 AS bachelor_plus,
  round(100.0 * (B15003_E022 + B15003_E023 + B15003_E024 + B15003_E025)
        / NULLIF(B15003_E001, 0), 2) AS bachelor_pct
FROM edu

outputs.name: Clean county health insurance
outputs.sql:
-- Health insurance coverage (table B27010). Uninsured = no coverage in each age group, summed.
SELECT
  GEOID AS fips,
  B27010_E001 AS insurance_pop,
  B27010_E017 + B27010_E033 + B27010_E050 + B27010_E066 AS uninsured_n,
  round(100.0 * (B27010_E017 + B27010_E033 + B27010_E050 + B27010_E066)
        / NULLIF(B27010_E001, 0), 2) AS uninsured_pct
FROM ins

outputs.name: Clean county home value
outputs.sql:
-- Median home value (table B25077). Placeholder values like -666666666 become NULL.
SELECT
  GEOID AS fips,
  CASE WHEN B25077_E001 > 0 THEN B25077_E001 END AS home_value
FROM hv

outputs.name: County shapes and land area
outputs.sql:
-- One row per county polygon, with its area in km2 (geodesic) used as the weight for state averages.
SELECT
  fips,
  name,
  county,
  state,
  state_fips,
  round(ST_Area_Spheroid(ST_FlipCoordinates(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(geometry))) / 1000000.0, 1) AS area_km2,
  geometry
FROM us

transforms.name: 2a Join shapes with income and education

outputs.name: Counties with income and education
outputs.sql:
-- Keep every county shape; add income and education by FIPS code (LEFT JOIN, so no county is dropped).
SELECT
  g.*,
  i.median_hh_income,
  i.per_capita_income,
  e.edu_pop_25plus,
  e.bachelor_plus,
  e.bachelor_pct
FROM geo g
LEFT JOIN inc i ON i.fips = g.fips
LEFT JOIN edu e ON e.fips = g.fips

outputs.name: Counties with all factors
outputs.sql:
-- Add health insurance and home value by FIPS code (LEFT JOIN, so every county is kept).
SELECT
  b.*,
  ins.insurance_pop,
  ins.uninsured_n,
  ins.uninsured_pct,
  hv.home_value
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN ins ON ins.fips = b.fips
LEFT JOIN hv ON hv.fips = b.fips

outputs.name: County metrics and scores
outputs.sql:
-- Derived metrics and 0-100 scores. Each factor is a percentile rank among counties
-- that have all four inputs; socio_score is the equal-weight average of the four scores.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    home_value * 1.0 / NULLIF(median_hh_income, 0) AS price_to_income
  FROM base
),
ok AS (
  SELECT fips, median_hh_income, bachelor_pct, uninsured_pct, price_to_income
  FROM m
  WHERE median_hh_income IS NOT NULL AND bachelor_pct IS NOT NULL
    AND uninsured_pct IS NOT NULL AND price_to_income IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    fips,
    percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY median_hh_income) AS r_income,
    percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY bachelor_pct) AS r_edu,
    percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY uninsured_pct DESC) AS r_health,
    percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY price_to_income DESC) AS r_housing
  FROM ok
)
SELECT
  m.fips, m.name, m.county, m.state, m.state_fips, m.area_km2,
  m.median_hh_income, m.per_capita_income,
  m.bachelor_pct, m.uninsured_pct, m.home_value,
  round(m.price_to_income, 2) AS price_to_income,
  round(100 * r.r_income, 1) AS income_score,
  round(100 * r.r_edu, 1) AS education_score,
  round(100 * r.r_health, 1) AS health_score,
  round(100 * r.r_housing, 1) AS housing_score,
  round(100 * (r.r_income + r.r_edu + r.r_health + r.r_housing) / 4, 1) AS socio_score,
  m.geometry
FROM m
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.fips = m.fips

outputs.name: State averages
outputs.sql:
-- Each state's average of the county values, weighted by county area (area_km2).
-- For each metric only counties with a value count, in both the sum and the weight total.
SELECT
  state_fips,
  any_value(state) AS state_abbr,
  count(*) AS counties,
  count(socio_score) AS counties_scored,
  round(sum(area_km2), 0) AS area_km2,
  round(sum(median_hh_income * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE median_hh_income IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE median_hh_income IS NOT NULL), 0), 0) AS avg_median_hh_income,
  round(sum(bachelor_pct * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE bachelor_pct IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE bachelor_pct IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS avg_bachelor_pct,
  round(sum(uninsured_pct * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE uninsured_pct IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE uninsured_pct IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS avg_uninsured_pct,
  round(sum(price_to_income * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE price_to_income IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE price_to_income IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS avg_price_to_income,
  round(sum(income_score * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE income_score IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE income_score IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS income_score,
  round(sum(education_score * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE education_score IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE education_score IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS education_score,
  round(sum(health_score * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE health_score IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE health_score IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS health_score,
  round(sum(housing_score * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE housing_score IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE housing_score IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS housing_score,
  round(sum(socio_score * area_km2) FILTER (WHERE socio_score IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(sum(area_km2) FILTER (WHERE socio_score IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS socio_score
FROM cm
GROUP BY state_fips

outputs.name: State map layer
outputs.sql:
-- State shapes with their area-weighted averages, ready to map.
SELECT
  st.fips AS state_fips,
  st.name AS state_name,
  avg.state_abbr,
  avg.counties,
  avg.counties_scored,
  avg.area_km2,
  avg.avg_median_hh_income,
  avg.avg_bachelor_pct,
  avg.avg_uninsured_pct,
  avg.avg_price_to_income,
  avg.income_score,
  avg.education_score,
  avg.health_score,
  avg.housing_score,
  avg.socio_score,
  st.geometry
FROM st
LEFT JOIN avg ON avg.state_fips = st.fips
